definitions.explanation: A transparent liquid essential for life.

notes:
{水|みず} refers to water—the essential liquid for life, used for drinking, washing, and many other purposes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink water
- {水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to pour water on
- {水|みず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to let bygones be bygones (idiom)
- お{水|みず}: water (polite, often in restaurants)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧: Wednesday
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧: water supply, tap water
- ⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧: flood
- ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧: swimming
- ⟦{水着|みずぎ}→水着：00286_mizugi⟧: swimsuit
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧: moisture, water content
- ⟦{冷水|れいすい}→冷水：22480_reisui⟧: cold water

CULTURAL NOTE:
{水|みず} is one of the five elements (⟦{五行|ごぎょう}→五行：28111_gogyou⟧) in East Asian philosophy.

- ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧: hot water (often for bathing)
